title: Fix Procedural 3d Default Example Dropdown
description: procedural 3d: There is a bug that the playground shows No example but it shows the hexagonal column. Make sure the default example shows in the dropdown.
summary: Fixed React OS shell boot so the example dropdown seeds the first registered example when nothing is locked/defaulted (matching wgpu sync_session_chrome). Procedural 3D now shows Hexagonal Mushroom Column in the navbar instead of No example while that fixture is already the default document.
